pain_point: Live labour-hour figures arrive a day late
Hours count as worked only after the shift ends
No visible warning when a shift crosses the five-hour break boundary
Auto-filled breaks land at the wrong end of long shifts
Open shifts are excluded from hour calculations
Deployment charts must be transcribed to paper twice a day
Crew cannot see their own punch history on mobile
Leave shifts must be entered one by one for a week of leave
Missed pay is added as a phantom shift in the next pay week
Pay periods are effectively never reopened for corrections
Managers share logins to fix their own timekeeping
Compliance warnings pile up and get dismissed without investigation
Feature availability varies by restaurant with no baseline
Most managers have never heard of the school calendar feature
Report literacy is low for group-level labour reporting
Role changes take up to two weeks to reach the platform
Forecast data transfers with a two-hour delay from the forecasting system
The payroll engine and the platform show different figures
New crew receive no standardised training on the platform
Training completions sync late from the learning platform
